name: whohasmystuff

repeats: the long-press menu marks a loan as returned without opening it
Lend again puts a returned loan back on the main list

notes: Four screens from the walk: the overflow and long-press menus, the date picker, the system contacts picker and the system calendar are not counted; Backup and Restore were not run and are taken to open no screen of their own. The loan's home is Edit; the main list's long-press Mark as Returned and History's Lend again change the same loan elsewhere, so they are repeats (delete from a menu and Add New are not counted, as in the other controls). Every run is null: there are no tags or search (R05), no photos or recognition (R06-R08), no places, only the person who has each thing, and every record is a dated loan (R09, R11), no map (R10) and no prices (R114, R115).
